build_docker_image_for_framework: build a docker image for a specific ML framework and push it to the container registry
build_all_framework_images: build and push docker images for all available ML frameworks in the docker_images directory
build_gpu_variant: build a GPU variant of a framework docker image using the --gpu flag
run_subprocess_command: run a shell command via subprocess and exit on failure using the run helper function
output_build_tags_to_file: write framework build tags to an output file using the --out argument
